content: Cognitive capacity is essential for the effective management of diabetes, as it enables individuals to make informed decisions about their self-care and to work collaboratively with healthcare providers. If cognitive decline is identified in a patient, it may be advantageous to include a lay care professional as part of the diabetes care team. This individual can assist with daily monitoring and act as a communication link with the broader care team. For young individuals with diabetes, support from parents or adult caregivers may be necessary until they reach a developmental stage where they can comprehend and independently act on critical diabetes management information.
